0.2: Do you know a boy named #b#p1052106##k in #b#m103000000##k? He's the silly one that wants to fly. He's had it for a while...\r\n#L0##bW-when do you think he'll return it?#l\n#k

no.0: Hm... I guess you're not that interested in learning. That's too bad.

1.3: Fine, you meanie... Fine, fine. I think flying with small wings looks silly anyway.
